BR elements in table cells are stripped when disabled

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"br_in_tables\":false}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><th>Col</th></tr><tr><td>A<br>B</td></tr></table>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
